events.did: stood at the back of the auditorium in sunglasses and spun the disc, watching the red dot on his screen continue west
events.quote_anchor: He spun the disc between his fingers, watching as the light bled out beyond the window, and the red dot on his screen continued west.

events.did: flagged down her latest TA to take her place in the exam hall and nodded Victor out of the auditorium
events.quote_anchor: Dani flagged down her latest TA—not the one who’d “fainted” in her lab—to take her place. She nodded at Victor

events.did: told Dani in her office that he needed to take a trip, without saying how long he would be gone
events.quote_anchor: “I need to take a trip,” he said, drawing off the dark sunglasses as the door swung shut behind him.

events.did: ejected the cartridge, set it on the desk and said the remaining drug would not be enough
events.quote_anchor: “I won’t be gone for very long,” he said, ejecting the cartridge. It was less than half full. He set it on the desk.

events.did: asked Dani to make an exception because he was not standing there holding a prescription
events.quote_anchor: “And I’m not standing here, holding a prescription,” he shot back, coldly. “I’m asking you to make an exception.”

events.did: reached into her pocket, produced a single vial and made him promise not to abuse it before handing it over
events.quote_anchor: She started to give it to him, but paused. “Promise me you won’t abuse it.”

events.did: froze Dani's hand when she lunged for the vial and retrieved the cartridge from beneath her frozen fingers
events.quote_anchor: Victor stepped forward, retrieving the cartridge from beneath her frozen fingers.

events.did: apologized to Dani, walked away and let her go as the door swung shut between them
events.quote_anchor: “I’ll be back soon,” he said, letting Dani go as the door swung shut between them.

relations.did: Dani still ran a weekly battery of tests on Victor to track his body's progress and the drug's long-term effects
relations.quote_anchor: he still submitted to a battery of tests each week, designed to track his body’s progress, as well as the drug’s long-term effects

relations.did: Eli appears to Victor as a phantom at the edge of his sight, and Victor dismisses him by turning a dial in his mind
relations.quote_anchor: Eli flickered at the edge of Victor’s sight. He crossed his arms, amusement playing on his face.

relations.did: Victor realizes Dani helps him because someone convinced Daniela Dean she wasn't good enough, and Victor is her way to prove them wrong
relations.quote_anchor: Someone had tried to convince Daniela Dean that she wasn’t good enough. And she needed to prove them wrong.

relations.did: Mitch has not answered Victor's message on the board, and each unanswered hour tips Victor toward certainty that something has gone wrong
relations.quote_anchor: every hour that Mitch didn’t answer his message on the board, was a pebble on the scales

numbers.did: how early he arrived for the appointment with Dani: two days
numbers.quote_anchor: He was two days early for their next appointment.

numbers.did: how full the cartridge was: less than half full
numbers.quote_anchor: It was less than half full. He set it on the desk.

numbers.did: how long the drug she gave him would last: a week, if he took it properly
numbers.quote_anchor: “Well, this will last a week. If you take it properly.”

numbers.did: how often the tests on Victor were run: each week
numbers.quote_anchor: he still submitted to a battery of tests each week, designed to track his body’s progress
